name: herdr
title: herdr-core backend
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Connect vqro to terminals owned by herdr-core.
description: Runs vqro-herdr, the default backend provider, using configured HC arguments or hc connect. It inventories terminals and forwards supported operations and streams. Turn it off to disconnect these resources from vqro; their programs remain owned by herdr-core. Another backend must be selected explicitly for new unnamed spawns if this is the declared default.

commands: Provider operations: spawn, kill, attach, resize and supported terminal operations
